key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week on rate-rise fears and oil price surge, signalling sharp risk-off rotation
AUD smashed as growth scare builds, pressuring import costs and commodity-linked equities
Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway, directly threatening BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX earnings trajectories
Oil price explosion (price suppression failing) drives 30c fuel price rise, hitting airlines and transport
RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate path and pressuring REITs
ANZ.AX post-3,500-job-cut restructuring plan faces long execution runway
Housing prices crashing while first-home buyers surge; no spring bounce in auction market
Mining cap-raise wave led by Canaccord signals capital stress across junior miners
Santos (STO.AX) preservation deemed a national sacrifice, raising energy security questions
AI theme bifurcates: Dell raises server forecast while top execs call to slow AI development

sectors.trend: Iron ore in active 'bloodletting' phase; junior miners scrambling for capital via Canaccord-led cap raises; small-cap movers (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) showing relative strength
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression; FMG.AX most exposed to price drops. Junior miners (SUN.AX, MNR.AX) volatile but speculative interest rising. Gold underperforming ('schmould') limits diversification appeal

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX restructuring post-3,500 cuts still early; RBA rental inflation concern complicates rate path; business confidence deteriorating
sectors.implications: NAB.AX, CBA.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher-for-longer rates but face credit risk from housing stress. ANZ.AX execution risk elevated. Superannuation reform debate (#45, #54) could reshape fund flows

sectors.trend: Oil price surge as suppression fails; fuel prices +30c; Santos preservation flagged as national sacrifice; airlines hit by input costs
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, STO.AX benefit from oil strength but face political/regulatory overhang. QAN.AX, SYD.AX squeezed by fuel costs and staff shortages (1 in 3 flights cancelled). LNG exporters gain from energy complex strength

sectors.trend: Woolworths (WES.AX) caught raising 'family staple' prices during Price Freeze promo; housing crash driving first-home buyer surge; NZ housing correction still running
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs vs. promotional discipline. Housing crash benefits construction (GRO.AX) but hurts REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) and mortgage lenders

sectors.trend: Dell raises AI server forecast twice; Palo Alto prices $1T AI security gap; Equinix finds AI data-centre niche; but top execs call to slow AI development; Apple still unproven on AI
sectors.implications: ASX-listed tech (WTC.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from global AI capex cycle. Caution warranted given regulatory pushback. US-listed exposure (DELL, PANW, EQIX) relevant for AUD-hedged portfolios

sectors.trend: RBA worried about rental inflation; housing prices crashing; no auction bounce; social rental build in Perth CBD underway
sectors.implications: Office and retail REITs (VCG.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure from falling occupier demand. Residential REITs (GPW.AX) face yield compression. Social housing policy shift may create new investment vehicles

key_themes: Oil-driven inflation shock complicating RBA rate path
Iron ore price correction pressuring ASX 200 heavyweight miners
AUD weakness amplifying import-cost inflation and equity outflows
Housing market inflection: prices falling, buyer activity rising
Mining sector capital stress: cap-raise wave signals liquidity concerns
AI capex cycle continues but faces regulatory headwinds
Superannuation reform debate gaining political traction
Energy security and Santos preservation as national policy priority

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price surge driving second-round inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel exposure; favour energy producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX) over consumers; monitor RBA response

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price 'bloodletting' compressing mining margins
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce FMG.AX, RIO.AX weight; favour gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and diversified miners (BHP.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD weakness and growth scare triggering capital outflows
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight export-oriented equities; consider AUD-USD hedge; monitor RBA intervention signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike surprise on rental inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration in fixed income; favour floating-rate REITs; monitor bond yields

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining junior cap-raise dilution and liquidity stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid small-cap miners without cash runway; favour ASX 100 names with balance-sheet strength

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing price crash triggering credit deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor NAB.AX, CBA.AX loan-loss provisions; reduce residential REIT exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight integrated energy producers on oil surge
opportunities.rationale: Oil price explosion and fuel cost pass-through support WDS.AX, WLE.AX, STO.AX earnings; Santos preservation signals policy tailwind

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate from iron ore pure-plays to diversified/gold miners
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting ongoing; gold underperforming but offers downside protection; BHP.AX diversification reduces single-commodity risk

opportunities.recommendation: Selective AI infrastructure exposure via global names
opportunities.rationale: Dell raising AI server forecast twice; Palo Alto $1T security gap; Equinix data-centre demand structural despite AI slowdown calls

opportunities.recommendation: Construction and housing-adjacent plays on buyer surge
opportunities.rationale: Housing prices crashing but first-home buyers surging; social rental build in Perth signals policy support for construction sector

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce FMG.AX and pure iron ore exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Active price bloodletting; no near-term demand catalyst; China growth concerns persist

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness; favour export-revenue equities
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; import-cost inflation rising; export earners benefit from weaker currency

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim residential and office REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental inflation concern may force rate hikes; housing crash pressures occupier demand and valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid junior miners in cap-raise cycle
defensive_moves.rationale: Canaccord-led mining cap raises signal dilution risk and capital stress; speculative small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone) high volatility

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to consolidate lower near-term as $90bn weekly outflow, oil-driven inflation scare, and AUD weakness dominate. RBA rental inflation commentary raises rate-hike risk. Expect volatility in miners and energy; banks mixed. 1–3 month range likely 8,200–8,600 on ^AXJO.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and iron ore finds a floor. Housing correction may create entry points for construction and select REITs. AI capex cycle provides structural tech support. Superannuation reform debate could redirect fund flows. Key variable: RBA rate path and China demand trajectory.

Global AI capex signals (Dell, PANW, EQIX earnings)
